english.title: Possess insurance document with intent to deceive
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), with intent to deceive, had in your possession a

(A)_[document]_
(B)_[thing]_

so closely resembling a

(C)_[certificate of insurance]_
(D)_[document produced as evidence of compulsory insurance pursuant to regulation 6 of the Motor Vehicles (Compulsory Insurance)(No 2) Regulations 1973]_
(E)_[document issued under regulations made by virtue of the power under section 165(2)(a) of the Road Traffic Act 1988]_

as to be calculated to deceive
english.legislation: Contrary to section 173(1)(c) of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

INDICTMENT: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
